purpose: Teach: 伴奏/ダンサー/路面/アルファベット/質量/だらだら/燃費/ツーリング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 結婚式の時、君のピアノ伴奏、感動したな、ばあさん。
lines.en: I was really moved watching you accompany on piano at the wedding, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, distant gaze inward. Quiet voice, tender on 'moved'. Pace slow enough to let the memory settle. Slight smile in the voice—not performed, just there.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、ダンサーに憧れたものよ、私、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. When I was young, I dreamed of being a dancer, you know. Really did.
lines.style: Soft laugh under the surface. Slightly wistful at 'dreamed'—a gentle regret that's made peace with itself. Voice lilts on the final phrase, affectionate, almost talking to herself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、路面、凍結に注意するように、なったな、私たち。
lines.en: We have to be careful about the frost on the roads these days, don't we.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact observation. Quiet concern woven in without alarm. Slight pause before 'don't we'—checking in, including her. The voice of someone getting older and noticing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫が、アルファベット、もう覚えたって、聞いたわよ、すごいわね。
lines.en: I heard your grandchild's already learned the alphabet. Isn't that wonderful.
lines.style: Genuine delight, bright but not loud. Warm attention on 'wonderful'—the pleasure of small family news. Voice settles on the final word with quiet pride, like she's already told this to someone else.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の物理の教科書、質量の話、難しかったな、覚えてるか?
lines.en: That old physics textbook—the bit about mass was difficult, wasn't it. Do you remember?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reaching back. Slight strain on 'difficult'—genuinely remembering the struggle. Leans forward with the question, inviting her into the shared memory. Warm curiosity, not testing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、家で、だらだらと、過ごしちゃうわね、二人で。
lines.en: Lately we just spend our time lazing around at home together, don't we.
lines.style: Self-aware, gently self-deprecating. Dry warmth—not complaining, just naming what is. Slight amused note, like she's caught herself being content in an unexpected way. Voice trails slightly, comfortable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃の車、燃費、悪かったよな、ガソリン代、つらかった。
lines.en: The cars we had when we were young got terrible gas mileage. Remember how painful the fuel costs were?
lines.style: Rueful chuckle underlying the words. Matter-of-fact about the hardship—memory without sting. Voice settles on 'painful' with shared recognition, like he's still feeling the ghost of that pinch in the wallet.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、あなたと、バイクツーリング、よく行ったわね、昔。
lines.en: When we were young, we used to go on motorcycle tours together so often, didn't we.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy. Voice drifts on 'so often'—lost in the particular texture of those years. Affectionate gaze at him underneath the words. Slight trailing-off, like she's checking if he remembers too. Tender and assumptive.
